:131-152 ITEM_BLOCK_REFERENCE admits ISSUE_KEY in the artifact/<slug>/comment form and any [^/?#]+ item id; Go reads that form only for a project key and refuses a bad item id, so for such values TS says 'is a block of a comment' where Go says 'is not a block reference'. Both refuse. Narrow to Go's two shapes, decode the id as Go does, add corpus rows.

:122-141 blockHolds' anyKind flag never gives a different answer (comment/message block refs hold only mentions) and its comment contradicts cmd/dispatch/AGENTS.md:628. Use one rule, any kind, for every holder.
